desc: Ideation: reformulation (`ans = max_j suf[j+1] + L(j)`), transition rule (append + suffix `+1`), record-stack + DSU design, pitfalls
**T1-T3 (implementation):** single-file solution — fast I/O, `pre`/`suf`/`prev_occ`, record stack with DSU, main loop `j=2..N-1`, print answer

**T4/T5 (validation):** brute-force oracle reasoning + traces on samples (5, 9), `N=3`, all-equal, all-distinct, and a case exercising the `head < p` branch with a `d[q]→0` head deletion (`1 2 2 2 3` → 5); invariants re-verified by the orchestrator (tail value `= pre[j-2]+1`, at most one pop on append, no deletion cascade, DSU never reaches sentinel since `head ≥ 1` when the else-branch is taken, `p ≤ j-1` guarantees `nxt[q]` exists)
**T6 (performance):** O(N·α) single pass with plain lists and inline path compression; ~3·10⁵ light iterations is comfortably within limits for N = 3·10⁵ — final code delivered
